verdict.rationale: Ultrametric does ship installable skill files: `ultrametric init` previews and then writes selected skill files, the CLI adds Ultrametric instructions to Codex and Claude Code projects, and the files can be committed for team sharing. Nothing in the pack shows these skills activating automatically from task context, or descriptions written to steer when the agent picks a skill. missing for 10: documented automatic context-based triggering, evidence of engineered skill descriptions/activation criteria, hands-on or independent corroboration of correct skill selection.
